DX
NIKKOR 40mm 128G
Versatile set of three Nikon DX mount lenses. This bundle
includes an AF-S Nikkor 55-300mm 1:4.5-5.6G ED VR telephoto
zoom lens, an AF-S Nikkor 35mm 1:1.8G prime lens, and an AF-
S Micro Nikkor 40mm 1:2.8G macro lens. Each lens is black with
gold lettering and includes front and rear caps. The 35mm and
40mm lenses come with their respective Nikon lens hoods (HB-
46 and HB-61).
All good quality, no flaws, etc.
